column1: # FathomNet lowercase common names, confirmed by hand against WoRMS (WP-U8a2).
# Read by scripts/taxonomy_fauna_codegen.py (crosswalk fathomnet-concepts); a row replaces the label's generated edge.
# match_type: exact | broader | unmapped.  aphia_id is the WoRMS AphiaID (accepted, rank as named); the codegen re-checks it against WoRMS.
# Rows are in box_count order, top down, to box-weighted coverage >= 0.95 and a little beyond (every label with >= 100 boxes).

gorgonians; Gorgonacea and Alcyonacea are unaccepted in WoRMS (valid = Octocorallia) and the accepted gorgonian orders Malacalcyonacea/Scleralcyonacea split them, so the smallest accepted clade holding all sea fans is Octocorallia
